mentions.name: ECAD Forge
mentions.description: ECAD Forge is an online viewer for schematics, PCB layouts, 3D boards, and BOMs that works entirely without uploading files, creating accounts, or server-side preprocessing, letting users view electronics designs directly in the browser.
mentions.problem: Existing online viewers for electronics design files typically require uploading files, creating accounts, or server-side preprocessing.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on a no upload, no account, no server-side preprocessing online viewer for schematics, PCB layouts, 3D boards and BOMs called ECAD Forge -> https://ecadforge.app/
mentions.author: SunboX
